description: Tracks newsletter emails processed by the /wiki newsletter-ingest pipeline. The weekly loop reads emails from the listed senders newer than last_processed_date, ingests on-domain academic papers, then advances last_processed_date and appends thread IDs here. Gmail MCP is READ-ONLY (no label writes), so state lives in this file, not in Gmail labels.
notes: alphaXiv digests expose arXiv IDs directly (reliable).
nlpnews 'Top AI Papers' mask IDs behind substack redirects — resolve+verify before ingest.
nlpnews 'AI Agents Weekly' are paywalled previews — papers section not in email body; low yield.
Every candidate arXiv ID is verified against arxiv.org/abs/{id} before download.

runs.notes: NLP 08-09 (10) + 08-16 (10) + alphaXiv 08-06/08-13 (7 arXiv-backed; 2 alphaXiv-native skipped: 2608.blog Qwen3.8-Max, 2608.leanstral). Both AI Agents Weekly (08-08, 08-15) re-confirmed paywalled previews, but their TOCs named 2 papers not in the digests -> recovered via search and ingested (2608.09096 Evo-Bench, 2608.08453 138K SKILL.md). All 29 IDs verified vs citation_title; 0 dups. New concept: catastrophic-remembering, anchoring a 6-paper convergence that accumulation != compounding. 7 Contradiction/qualification callouts filed (self-improving-agent x2, agentic-context-engineering, self-reflection, reflexion, scaling-laws, grouped-query-attention, llm-as-a-judge). PDF verification caught the worst fabrication rate yet: 3 figures in the Prompt-Induced-Waste blurb appear nowhere in the paper. Product news (DeepSeek Harness v0.1, V4-Pro) recorded on the deepseek entity, flagged vendor-reported. Cursor -> 2026-08-17. 8 agents, 0 infra failures.

runs.type: newsletter sweep (manual, NLP x2 + alphaXiv x3 + AI Agents Weekly x2)
runs.notes: All 31 IDs verified vs citation_title, 0 dups. Committed in two parts: the first fan-out of 8 agents hit the session rate limit and all 8 died, but 15 verified pages were already on disk and were committed as a checkpoint; the remaining 16 were re-run as 4 agents. Introduced topic_watchlist to track paywalled AI Agents Weekly TOC keywords (resolved/product/unresolved) — recovered 4 papers from the 08-29 issue alone; 3 keywords have no arXiv presence. New concepts: skill-routing, skill-selection. Contradiction filed on harness-vs-model-attribution: the 13.3% raw ARC-AGI-3 baseline may be GPT-5.6 Terra not Sol, so the 6.4x harness effect is unverified; on the same backbone NVIDIA 85.1% beats Prime Agent 78.3%. Two counter-examples to catastrophic-remembering (Meta^n, WikiSkill) that escape via outcome-grounded provenance rather than pruning. Compaction Cliff and Lost-in-Compaction reconciled: agree on the fix, one conflict on positional-bias mechanism. Lesson: cap parallel ingest agents at ~4.

runs.type: newsletter sweep (manual, NLP Top-Papers + AI Agents Weekly)
runs.notes: 11 papers surfaced, WikiSkill (2608.27454) already ingested 2 days prior and caught by dedupe. 3 agents (kept under the limit after the 09-05 failure). Declarative Attention reframed: decode-time not prefill, so NOT a fourth sparse-prefill family - filed under sparse-attention with a phase warning; also KAIST not DeepMind. Contradiction filed on graph-memory: graph retrieval loses to flat vectors at matched budget (F1 0.417 vs 0.468), multi-hop advantage absent, cost is informational not engineering; graph forgetting survives, hipporag-2 exempt. E-Commerce Bench vs MerchantBench reconciled by normalizing to opening capital (19.8x vs 14.3x - MerchantBench agents did better and were still at 27.3% of human). Third propagation mechanism identified (social evidence of unenforced rules) vs EvoMal imitation and Mind Viruses instruction. RHAE dispute advanced: OpenAI's own table puts GPT-5.6 Sol at 7.8%, so the harness effect is likely ~11x not 6.4x - correction direction flipped. New: tau-bench, purdue-university. Watchlist +14 entries (36 total).
